# Northbound
Northbound is an independent publication covering crypto bridges and cross-chain infrastructure.
It explains how value moves between blockchains for users, developers, and researchers.
Coverage includes bridge launches, exploits, audits, governance, validators, liquidity routes, and security.
## Key pages
- Homepage: https://cryptogurutalk.github.io/
- About: https://cryptogurutalk.github.io/about/
- Editorial focus: clear reporting on the mechanics and risks of moving value across chains.
- Publisher: Northbound
